role: HTTP/REST API — axum port of Jellyfin.Api (61 controllers)

contract.strategy: Register EVERY vendored path+method as an axum route so a real client (Wolphin) never 404s on a known route. First-Light + core routes get REAL handlers; every other route returns 501 Not Implemented via a shared `not_implemented` handler. A HARD-GATE test diffs the registered route table against the vendored spec and asserts hermit-api is a SUPERSET (every vendored path+method is registered).

conventions.handlers_depend_only_on: hermit-traits manager traits via AppState (Arc<dyn Trait>) — never hermit-core directly; concrete impls injected at composition root (hermit-server, Wave 8).
conventions.error_taxonomy: hermit_traits::ServiceError { NotFound->404, Unauthorized->401, InvalidInput->400, Db->500, Backend->500 }; error.rs wraps it in an ApiError newtype with IntoResponse.
conventions.auth_seam: hermit_traits::net::{RequestContext, AuthorizationContext (parse), AuthService (validate->401)} + options::AuthorizationInfo. Middleware/extractor builds RequestContext from axum headers+query, calls AuthorizationContext::get_authorization_info, injects AuthorizationInfo as a request extension. Jellyfin token: `Authorization`/`X-Emby-Authorization` header (MediaBrowser Token=...) or `api_key`/`ApiKey` query param.

units.name: unit 1 — INFRA
contents: AppState { library: Arc<dyn LibraryManager>, users: Arc<dyn UserManager>, user_views: Arc<dyn UserViewManager>, user_data: Arc<dyn UserDataManager>, media_sources: Arc<dyn MediaSourceManager>, sessions: Arc<dyn SessionManager>, system: Arc<dyn SystemManager>, app_host: Arc<dyn ServerApplicationHost>, config: Arc<dyn ServerConfigurationManager>, dto: Arc<dyn DtoService>, auth_context: Arc<dyn AuthorizationContext>, auth_service: Arc<dyn AuthService> } — Clone (all Arc).
error.rs: ApiError(ServiceError) with impl IntoResponse mapping variants to StatusCode + JSON body; From<ServiceError>.

auth.rs: token middleware/extractor — RequestContext from headers+query -> AuthorizationContext::get_authorization_info -> AuthorizationInfo request extension; RequireAuth extractor calls AuthService::authenticate (401 on failure).
router.rs: create_router(AppState) -> Router — merges real-handler routes + registers all 412 vendored path+method pairs (un-ported -> not_implemented).
not_implemented handler: async fn -> StatusCode::NOT_IMPLEMENTED (501) shared across every stub route.
openapi.rs: utoipa ApiDoc aggregating the real handlers (paths/components).

tests/contract_superset.rs (HARD GATE): load vendored spec via jq/serde_json, enumerate every (path, method); assert each is present in create_router's registered route table; fail if any vendored path+method is missing.
units.notes: Path syntax: convert Jellyfin `{itemId}` -> axum `{itemId}`. Case-sensitive paths preserved verbatim (/System/Info, /Users/Me).

units.name: unit 2 — FIRST-LIGHT real handlers
contents: GET /System/Info -> SystemManager::get_system_info(&ctx)
GET /System/Info/Public -> SystemManager::get_public_system_info(&ctx)
POST /Users/AuthenticateByName -> UserManager::authenticate_user + SessionManager::authenticate_new_session -> AuthenticationResult
GET /Users/Me -> AuthorizationInfo (extension).user -> UserManager::get_user_by_id -> UserDto
GET /UserViews -> UserViewManager::get_user_views(user_id) -> QueryResult<BaseItemDto> (via DtoService::get_base_item_dtos)
GET /Items -> LibraryManager::query_items(InternalItemsQuery) -> DtoService::get_base_item_dtos -> QueryResult<BaseItemDto>
GET /Items/{itemId} -> LibraryManager::get_item_by_id -> DtoService::get_base_item_dto (404 if None)
GET /Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo -> MediaSourceManager::get_playback_media_sources -> PlaybackInfoResponse
POST /Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo -> MediaSourceManager::get_playback_media_sources (posted body) -> PlaybackInfoResponse

GET|HEAD /Videos/{itemId}/stream -> LibraryManager::get_item_by_id -> MediaSourceManager::get_static_media_sources -> tokio::fs file body with HTTP Range (206 Partial Content, Accept-Ranges, Content-Range)
GET|HEAD /Items/{itemId}/Images/{imageType} -> basic file serve from item image path, or 404 (full image pipeline deferred to unit 3)
units.notes: First-Light handler->trait map (also in first_light_routes). AuthenticationResult, UserDto, BaseItemDto, QueryResult, PlaybackInfoResponse all in hermit-model. UserData/Resume (GetItemUserData /UserItems/... , GetResumeItems /UserItems/Resume) are 501 in unit 2, real in a later wave.
